errors.text_span: 刻度为离散的类别标签，无数值单位
errors.evidence: The x-axis represents conditions (A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2), which are categorical labels, but the statement 'no numerical units' is misleading; the y-axis has a numerical scale.

errors.text_span: 反映，图中包含两条线：红色实线带三角形标记的线代表“去除偏误”条件，其在 A1 处值为 0.0055
errors.evidence: While the description states that at A1 the value for '去除偏误' is 0.0055, it also states this is the same at B1 while it actually remains at 0.0051.
The description does not clearly communicate the purpose of the chart beyond stating 'the changes in network density'.
The description does not mention the connecting line styles or the presence of error bars on the data points.
